hypotheses.reasoning: template-svc lost capacity (instance restart, 3/4). notification-svc retries immediately with backoff disabled, so template-svc sees 3-4x baseline load and sheds with 503. The gateway 503s are the downstream effect. The status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts are a red herring, because that endpoint has been deprecated for a long time and fails throughout the window.
template-svc capacity shortfall could be read as the root cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: Enable retry backoff with jitter and a retry budget in notification-svc's TemplateClient. Restore template-svc capacity and investigate why its liveness probe failed. Ignore the legacy-inventory healthcheck.
